```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, dpi = 110,
  fig.align = "center"
)

# Source the pipeline to build the environment
source("incremental_fetch.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# Fail loudly if data shape is unexpected
stopifnot(
  is.data.frame(outbreak_df),
  all(c("date", "confirmed", "confirmed_deaths", "recovered") %in% names(outbreak_df)),
  is.data.frame(sir_full),
  all(c("time", "I", "R", "D") %in% names(sir_full)),
  is.data.frame(sir_proj),
  length(predicted_I) == nrow(outbreak_df),
  is.numeric(beta_est), is.numeric(gamma_est), is.numeric(mu_est)
)
